title: Rome, January 1478 st. fior. (1479): Giovanni Mazzinghi and an unsigned writer to the Medici, word-by-word cipher (ASF MAP LXXXIX 142, CXXXVII 252; key source MAP LXXII 170)

documents.shelfmark: ASF, Mediceo avanti il Principato LXXXIX 142

plaintext.source: Bare: no decipherment on or beside the leaf (vetting batch n08).

transcription.source: ASF IIIF A0000463, 1272 x 1837 (largest size served)
transcription.notes: Some sign pairs cannot be told apart at this resolution (o, 4, H, b/6).

documents.shelfmark: ASF, Mediceo avanti il Principato CXXXVII 252
documents.route: unsigned (same hand and signs as 2307) -> the Medici

system.summary: Letter substitution in letter-like signs with word division kept, numerals for persons and a barred p for per.
system.sibling_key: MAP LXXII 170 (lead 2308), same sign set, glossed interlinear; not yet rebuilt sign by sign
system.notes: 29 sign classes seen at 1272 px; several classes probably hold two or three signs.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of 2307 or 2320 found; the sibling LXXII 170 carries its own contemporary gloss.

conditions.human_role: Daniel Bourdeau chose the target; the model does the work. A second session worked 2307 from the catalogue task prompt pasted into Claude Code; no target-specific intervention.

solution.what: Full-size images of MAP LXXXIX 142, CXXXVII 252, LXXII 170 and neighbours downloaded from the ASF MAP viewer (getdoc.py).
Datelines read: all three 'gennaio 1478', i.e. January 1479 modern (Florentine style); 2307 headed 'In Roma'; LXXII 170 verso is show-through only.
2307: First pass of 89/142, 29 sign classes, 1055 signs.
2307: Paired the 72/170 gloss with its cipher; only 'publichamente mostra lectere' aligned with confidence.
2307: Homophonic annealer on it-cinquecento; collapsed onto all-i.
2307: Same with a letter-frequency KL penalty and swap moves; Italian came out (contra di voi molto crudele, molte volte, grandissimo).
2307: 537-sign Italian passage in a random 29-sign homophonic key: 655/667 letters right.
2307: Second transcription pass in 3x crops and word-by-word reading; merged sign classes resolved from context.

outcome.method_basis: The key came from a solver run on the ciphertext alone and was read out word by word; the one sibling gloss pair checked agrees but was not used to build it.
outcome.notes: 2307: 111 of 189 cipher words read, 30 doubtful, 48 open (fraction_read is for 2307). 2320 not yet transcribed. In progress: sibling key rebuild from LXXII 170 next.

gaps.item: 48 open cipher words and about 30 doubtful ones from merged sign classes
code numerals 2, 3, 10, 12, 30, 40 and groups olop, ov+, cop, oxP
